items.summary_en: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar wants the Mysuru Dasara procession to include cultures from southern States. He has asked other Chief Ministers to join the event.

items.raw_excerpt: This was emphasized to people watching a Senate hearing this week, where confusion over two basketball teams was on display.
items.summary_en: At a Senate hearing this week, people mixed up two basketball teams. One team is the Hawks and the other is the Hawkeyes. Everyone watching could see the confusion.

items.raw_excerpt: An international team led by archaeologist Prof. Cenker Atila of Sivas Cumhuriyet University is carrying out a government-approved investigation into the Durupınar Formation, a site 20 miles south of Mount Ararat, argued by some to be the possible remains of Noah’s Ark.
items.summary_en: A team of archaeologists is studying a rock site in eastern Turkey. The site is 20 miles south of Mount Ararat. Some people think it could be the remains of Noah's Ark.
items.summary_ko: 한 고고학 팀이 튀르키예 동부의 암석 지대를 조사하고 있다. 이곳은 아라라트산에서 남쪽으로 약 32킬로미터 떨어진 곳이다. 일부 사람들은 이 지형이 노아의 방주의 흔적일 수 있다고 본다.

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan will see cooler weather and intermittent rain in northern and eastern areas next week, with temperatures dipping to 19 degrees Celsius from Thursday, the Central Weather Administration (CWA) said Saturday.
items.summary_en: Taiwan will get cooler weather and off-and-on rain in the north and east next week. Temperatures could drop to 19 degrees Celsius starting Thursday. The Central Weather Administration shared this news on Saturday.

items.raw_excerpt: Indonesia has suspended the chief of a West Java prison and four senior officers after state inspectors found more than 10 apartment-style houses where inmates allegedly paid to live.
items.summary_en: Indonesia suspended a West Java prison chief and four officers. Inspectors found over 10 apartment-style houses where inmates paid to live. The homes had fitness equipment and liquor fridges.

items.title_en: Indonesia inmates pay to live in luxury prison houses

items.raw_excerpt: Have you spotted them in Portugal?
items.summary_en: Flamingos stop in Portugal's wetlands on their way from France to Spain. They turn pink by eating algae and small crustaceans. Birdwatchers can see them in the Algarve at places like Ria Formosa.
items.summary_ko: 플라밍고는 프랑스에서 스페인으로 이동하다 포르투갈 습지에 들른다. 이 새는 조류와 작은 갑각류를 먹으며 분홍색 깃털을 얻는다. 리아 포르모자 같은 알가르브 지역에서 플라밍고를 볼 수 있다.
items.title_en: Think pink: where to spot flamingos in Portugal

items.raw_excerpt: Beloved for its dinosaurs, Philadelphia's storied Academy of Natural Sciences closed down this week, amid an intense fight by local residents, politicians and scientists to save it.
items.summary_en: A famous natural history museum in Philadelphia closed this week. It is almost 200 years old and is loved for its dinosaurs. Local people, politicians, and scientists tried hard to save it.
items.summary_ko: 필라델피아의 유명한 자연사 박물관이 이번 주 문을 닫았다. 약 200년 역사의 이곳은 공룡 전시로 사랑받아 왔다. 주민과 정치인, 과학자들은 박물관을 지키려고 애썼다.

items.title_original: Just short of its 200th birthday, a landmark natural history museum shuts down

items.raw_excerpt: A study by the Fraunhofer Institute and the University of Münster has suggested that sodium-ion batteries, made of essentially salt, may be on the verge of economic viability.
items.summary_en: A study from the Fraunhofer Institute and the University of Münster looks at sodium-ion batteries. These batteries are made mostly from salt. The researchers say they may soon be cheap enough to use.

items.raw_excerpt: Lani Pallister won four gold medals and booked her spot at the world short course championships in Sydney this week, but that didn't stop her from flying to Queensland to win the Bluff to Bar ocean race.
items.summary_en: Lani Pallister won four gold medals at a short course event in Sydney. She still flew to Queensland to swim in the Bluff to Bar ocean race. She had a 4am wake-up call and did not want to miss out.

items.raw_excerpt: The Murcia Community government has announced a €16 million aid programme targeting young adults that offers up to €300 a month in rent subsidy for the entirety of 2026 and 2027, adding up to a total sum of €7,200 each for a group of 2,300 people.
items.summary_en: The Murcia region in Spain will spend 16 million euros on rent help. Young adults can get up to 300 euros a month. About 2,300 people will receive this support in 2026 and 2027.

items.raw_excerpt: The River Basin Management Service has launched a new app to engage local communities in Mayo, allowing individuals to record, store, and share their monitoring of aquatic wildlife.

items.raw_excerpt: Worried about stumbling before a high-stakes event, like a race or a job interview? Psychologist Cindra Kamphoff offers creative strategies to overcome the jitters and build confidence in the moment.
items.summary_en: Psychologist Cindra Kamphoff shares a creative way to handle nerves before big events. By imagining a mistake being flushed away, people can feel calmer and more confident.

items.raw_excerpt: Conab aponta que a média do preço pago ao produtor do limão tahiti passou de R$ 32,10 pela caixa de 27,2 kg em junho para R$ 55,60 em julho e R$ 104,78 em agosto.
